result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the featured 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, which is a significant visual defect on a primary content card.

issues.description: The main image of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section renders as a broken-image placeholder icon on a gray background instead of an actual photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL loads correctly or fall back to a branded placeholder/restaurant logo instead of the browser's broken-image icon.
